correctness.rationale: The 4-state generator is irreducible for u,v,d>0 and |δ|<1; its rooted spanning-tree cofactors sum to a positive normalization. Direct cofactor algebra yields J(δ)=4duv δ(p+2-δh)/D(δ) and its symmetrized current E=16duv δ²h[(p+2)²+4d(uv-1)-δ²h²]/[D(δ)D(-δ)]. The unique zero of the affine factor in δ² gives d1=(u+1)(v+1)/(1-uv)<d0=(p+2)²/[4(1-uv)] for uv<1, and other regimes have fixed sign. At d=d0 the even quadratic term vanishes and the quartic coefficient is -8duvh³/D0², nonzero since u≠v. Independent exact rational 4-state stationary solves give E(1/4)=-2304/246445121, E(1/2)=0, E(3/4)=80640/560485349 for u=1/2,v=3/2,d=63/4. Tests do not prove the polynomial identities, which follow from displayed cofactors.
